MQTT::client_id
Description
This command gets or sets the client identifier of MQTT CONNECT
message.
Syntax
MQTT
::
client_id
[
client_identifier
]
MQTT::client_id
Get the client identifier of MQTT CONNECT message.
MQTT::client_id <client_identifier>
Set the client identifier of MQTT CONNECT message to specified
string.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS, MQTT_CLIENT_DATA,
MQTT_SERVER_DATA
